posts.title: Fix a frozen app without losing work

slides.text:
Fix a frozen app without losing work
Press Ctrl+Shift+Esc to open Task Manager
Press Ctrl+Shift+Esc to open Task Manager
Find the app under Processes, not Apps
Right-click it and choose End task
Reopen it after 10 seconds — the cache has cleared
If it re-freezes, check for an update or reinstall it.
Save this — you'll need it next time.

posts.caption:
Fix a frozen app without losing work 🛠️

1. Press Ctrl+Shift+Esc to open Task Manager
2. Find the app under Processes, not Apps
3. Right-click it and choose End task
4. Reopen it after 10 seconds
     ✓ the cache has cleared
5. If it re-freezes, check for an update or reinstall it.

Save this for the next ticket →
